# DEI x VLABS Hackathon '26

> A national student hackathon organised by Dayalbagh Educational Institute (DEI), Agra, and Virtual Labs, an initiative of the Ministry of Education (MoE), Govt of India. Teams build working prototypes of next-generation virtual laboratory experiments.

## Key facts

- Organisers: Dayalbagh Educational Institute (Deemed to be University), Agra, and Virtual Labs (MoE, Govt of India, under the National Mission on Education through ICT).
- Eligibility: engineering and science students (UG, PG or Diploma).
- Team size: 1 to 4 members.
- Submission: a presentation on the official PPT template plus a working MVP or prototype.
- Dates: registration starts 18 January; submission deadline 30 January; shortlist announced 2 February; offline final round 7 February at DEI, Agra.
- Final round: 10 shortlisted teams compete offline at Dayalbagh Educational Institute, Agra. Accommodation is provided by the college.
- Judging: innovation and creativity 30%, technical complexity 30%, UX and interactivity 25%, alignment to theme 15%.
- Rewards: each student in the top 3 teams gets a Virtual Labs internship with a ₹15,000 per month stipend; certificates for all shortlisted teams.
- Contact: deivlabshackathon@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://deixvlabs.dei.ac.in/): about DEI and Virtual Labs, rules, judging criteria, roadmap, themes, rewards, FAQ and contacts.
- [Themes](https://deixvlabs.dei.ac.in/themes): provisional innovation tracks.
